meta.deduplicationRule: One randomly selected Central/Junction/Terminal mock record per cityId (fixed seed 20260828).
meta.codeRule: Real/representative Indian Railways station code assigned where a clear city-level railway station match exists; null otherwise.
meta.syntheticCodeRule: For previously-null codes: remove Central/Junction/Terminal from name; use first+second+last letter. If already used, use first+second+second-last+last. If that also collides, append a numeric suffix to preserve uniqueness.
